**An integrated metabolomic, transcriptomic and
genomic approach to identify new markers for the
genetic improvement of feed efficiency in Italian pigs**

## Research team and collaboration

FEEDTHEPIG was coordinated by
[Prof. Francesca Bertolini](https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/francesca.bertolini3/en).

My research activities were conducted within
the [Animal and Food Genomics Group](https://site.unibo.it/animal-and-food-genomics/en),
led by [Prof. Luca Fontanesi](https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/luca.fontanesi/en).

## Project overview

FEEDTHEPIG investigated the genetic and molecular
determinants of feed efficiency in Italian pig
populations, with particular emphasis on Italian
Large White and Italian Duroc breeds.

The project combined high-throughput metabolomics,
transcriptomics and genomic information to identify
molecular biomarkers associated with feed efficiency.

These approaches aimed to improve the characterization
of feed efficiency and support genomic selection
strategies for more sustainable pig production.


## My research contribution

My research activities are associated with
the computational characterization of
metabolomic variability and the integration
of molecular and genomic information in pigs.

The analytical approaches include the
comparison of metabolomic profiles, the
investigation of metabolite associations
with complex traits and the identification
of candidate molecular biomarkers relevant
to feed efficiency and growth.

These activities contribute to understanding
the molecular variability underlying
production-related traits in pig populations.
